page.layout: Two parallel columns of Hebrew-Latin dictionary entries, left column then right column. Running head at top centre in Hebrew letters, page number at top left. Letter headings centred in the left column ("ל ל", "ל מ") and in the right column at the head. Catchword alone at bottom right.

main_text.l: לָכַת, לָכֶת ire, לְכָהָךְ ire te, בִּלְכַתָּם in ire eos, בְּלֶכְתָּן eas, &c. Infin. Kal, præf. & aff. Rad. יָלַךְ.
main_text.head: ל ל
main_text.l: לַלָּאות, לְלָאוֹת laqueoli, No. pl. fæm. abs. & constr. à f m. No. Rad. לוֹל cochlea.
לְלַבֵּן ad dealbandum, Dan. 11.35. (pro לְהַלְבֵּן,) Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. לָבַן.
לָלִין ad pernoctandum, (pro לְהָלִין,) Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. לוּן.
לָלֶדֶת ad pariendum, 1.Sam. 4.19 (pro לְלֶדֶת,) Inf. Kal, præf. Rad. יָלַד.
main_text.head: ל מ
main_text.l: לָמָּה, & לְמָּה, vel לָמָה quare? comp. ex מָה, præf. & No. interrog. מָה.
לָמוֹ illis, comp. ex ל, præf.
לְמוֹתֵת ad morte afficiendum, Infin. Piel, præf. R. מוּת.
לְמָחוֹת ad delendum, Infin. Kal, præf. R. מָחָה.
לְמָחוֹת ad delendum, Prov. 31.3. (pro לְהַמָּחוֹת,) Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. מָחָה.
לְמִלִּין verbis, præf. cum No. pl. R. מָלַל locutus est.
לְמְלָכְתּ operi, Jer.7.18. cum defectu א, pro לִמְלָאכְתּ, R. לָאךְ.
לְמְנוֹת ad numerandum, Infin. Kal, R. מָנָה.
לְמְנַצֵּחַ præcentori, (pro לְהַמְנַצֵּחַ,) Part. Piel, f. m. præf. Rad. נָצַח vicit.
לְמַעַן propter, ut, Part. cauf. præf. R. מַעַן.
לְמְרוֹת ad exacerbandum, Jef. 3.8. (pro לְהַמְרוֹת,) Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. מָרָה.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and dagesh are reproduced from a low-resolution scan and are doubtful throughout; the consonants are likelier to be right than the points. The running head Hebrew letters and the letter headings are read from the scan and may not be exact. Left-column entry "לָלָּאות" and the bare Hebrew forms in the last lines are uncertain; no [?] markers were added to keep the Hebrew legible, so check those against the printed page. Catchword read as לנ.
